FN-TBECH15-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 659
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Representative Prince Chestnut
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/07/2026
House Bill 659 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the State
Department of Education to publish a standardized version of the Bill of Rights by January 1,
2027, and to make a printable electronic format of the document available at no-cost to the local
boards of education.
This bill would also increase the obligations of the local boards of education to display a
physical copy of the standardized version of the Bill of Rights in every classroom beginning in
the 2027-2028 school year, which would have an estimated aggregate fiscal impact of greater
than $50,000 annually on all local boards of education and is subject to the provisions of Section
111.05 of the Constitution of Alabama of 2022.
